|errata_history=This card has one published text. The images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-roguesquadrontactics-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 7.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Rogue_Squadron_Tactics.png]]); both print it.
* First printed in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ non-[Virtual Block 1] Alderaan or Dressel, and/or a [Death Star II] Rogue Squadron pilot (except Tycho). Once per turn, if you just Force drained at a battleground system, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 15, 2010"; PDF made 23 December 2010), Light Side p. 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* The PC website card list (Virtual Block 7 and Virtual Master lists, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows “Deploy on table. Once per game, may /\ non-[Virtual Block 1] Alderaan or Dressel, and/or a [Death Star II] Rogue Squadron pilot (except Tycho). Once per turn, if you just Force drained at a battleground system, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to Alter.”<ref name="cl-1272_24-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref> It writes ▲ as “/\” and the Immune to Alter icon in words; the wording is the same, so it is not a separate version.
* The Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text (Light Side p. 28).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> (The text layer of the sheet and Master List PDFs has a stray second comma after “Once per game”; the printed slips have one comma.)
